claims; do not omit material qualifications to fit. Your support and coverage
claims are proposals, not independently verified. No Markdown.
Write every claim text and missing item in Spanish, even when the question and source use another language. Preserve names and quoted evidence verbatim. Include only claims needed to answer the requested aspects.

Task requirements:
- Enumerar en orden las actividades 18, 19, 20, 21 y 22.
